title: Project Execution
prompt:
Assign project tasks A-J to exactly five ordered nonempty stages. Every task appears exactly once and each stage may contain at most three tasks.

Task labels: A Requirements Baseline; B Environment Inventory; C Acceptance Criteria; D Interface Plan; E Data Mapping; F Test Harness; G Integrated Prototype; H Validation Report; I Quality Review; J Operations Review.

Rules:
- Foundation gate: A, B, and C must all be complete before any of D, E, or F begins.
- D before G.
- E before G.
- E before H.
- F before H.
- Acceptance gate: G and H must both be complete before either I or J begins.
- Project completion may be declared only after both I and J are complete.

Return one JSON object with this shape:
{"result":{"stages":[["A","B","C"],["D"],["E","F"],["G","H"],["I","J"]],"completion_stage":5}}
Any valid five-stage plan is accepted.
